meta.title: Verify the record | Puntr
meta.description: Check that a Puntr pick has not been changed. Paste a pick ID and your browser recomputes its fingerprint. Every pick is locked, linked to the one before it and fingerprinted daily.

title: Verify the record
subtitle: Every pick has a fingerprint (a hash) that depends on the pick and on the pick before it. If anything were changed, the fingerprints would stop matching. Check one yourself: your browser does the sums, not Puntr.

how.title: How the fingerprint is made
how.p1: When a pick is locked, Puntr joins these facts into one line of text, with nothing between them: the fingerprint of the previous pick, the member's ID, the match ID, the market, the selection, the handicap line (blank unless it's a handicap), the odds with two decimals, and the exact time it was locked, to the microsecond, in UTC.
how.p2: That line is run through SHA-256, a standard fingerprinting method. The result is the pick's hash. Because it includes the previous pick's hash, the picks form a chain: changing any old pick would change every hash after it.
how.p3: Each night just before midnight (South African time) Puntr also records the day's last hash and pick count below. Compare them with your own copy to see that the chain was not rewritten later.

check.title: Check a pick
check.label: Pick ID
check.hint: Open any pick and use its hash link, or paste its ID here.
check.invalid: That doesn't look like a pick ID. It is a long code such as 9faaef2d-f559-4698-868f-73f1c0f669a9.
check.error: We couldn't load that pick. Please try again.

result.matchBody: Your browser recomputed this pick's hash from its facts and got the same result as the record. The pick has not been changed.
result.noMatchBody: The recomputed hash is different from the stored one. Please tell us at support@puntr.co.za.
result.links: Linked to the pick before it: yes
result.linksNo: Linked to the pick before it: NO, the previous pick's hash does not match
result.first: This is the first pick on Puntr.
